data.one_liner: Dart library for geospatial analysis, distance calculations, coordinate conversions and astronomy.
data.what_it_does: GeoEngine provides geospatial and geomatic calculations including distance algorithms, coordinate conversions, map projections, MGRS, and astronomy support like moon phases and eclipses. It also includes support for GeoDataframe and Geoseries operations.
use_when: You need precise distance, bearing, and geodetic calculations in pure Dart.
You are converting coordinates between lat/lng, UTM, MGRS, and custom projections.
Your application requires astronomical calculations such as sun/moon positions, eclipses, and Julian dates.
avoid_when: You only need to display an interactive map widget in your UI.
You need high-level UI mapping widgets rather than raw geospatial math operations.
strengths: Comprehensive suite of geodetic and coordinate transformation utilities.
Includes niche features like astronomical calculations and Julian date conversions.
Pure Dart support across multiple platforms.
weaknesses: Does not include native interactive map rendering widgets.
Documentation is mostly centered around code snippets in the README.
